changelog: Fixed a major bug where live TV could get stuck reconnecting in fullscreen on some providers — the disk cache used for live rewind is now removed (rewind still works via a ~2min in-memory buffer). Fixed a DNS-over-HTTPS slowdown, a Series tab crash on corrupted provider data, Favorites tab not scrolling to the playing channel, and an autofill bug in Add Server. Added genre folders on Series/Movies, a Most Reliable sort option, a Provider Health dashboard, an in-app QR scanner for TV backup restore, full on-device TV backup/restore, working cloud auto-sync, and a draggable/resizable Picture-in-Picture window.
